scope: Readiness of every EuRoC/Rosario/ZED dataset-mode-algorithm with planned runs and no readiness entry: bounded checks in main (EuRoC MH_01 30 s, Rosario sequence1 60 s, ZED field1 60 s) where a configuration or build had never run, otherwise the full-sequence integration-clone pilot with byte-identical configuration files plus main's bounded check of the estimator; applies to all sequences of the dataset. HortiMulti entries record execution only (review incomplete).
review_basis: Declared claim items are settled by recorded decisions: failures under a correct setup stay as measured results, both VIO-LC trajectory kinds are reported with a note (MASt3R-Fusion keyframe-only global trajectory; SVO Pro window-gated export with forward-only loop correction), VIO and VIO-LC stay separate executions (docs/claude-new-algorithms-setup-20261003.md section 4, 3 October); every Rosario row keeps the authors' ORB-SLAM3 camera model with the 0.365 deg Kalibr camera-IMU transform and zero offset (docs/rerun-plan-20261003.md section 1, 3 October); ORB-SLAM3 attempts outside ZED and OpenVINS EuRoC VIO are replaced in one new group (docs/campaigns/user-rerun-decisions-20261003.json); AirSLAM keeps its sparse keyframe claim; ZED rows carry the nominal-position claim with RTK float, mounting and clock limits and the reviewed physical camera-IMU calibration (docs/campaigns/zed-physical-calibration-20261002.json).
